arguments.text: All six legacy cells reproduced exactly. For phi=4/5, L=8, the checked variance ratio is 18112777/31640625; the limiting coverage prediction is 0.861911901848, using c=1.96. Proof obligations: (1-phi) sum X_t=sum innovations+phi(X_0-X_n), so CLT uses iid finite-variance innovations; fixed-lag sample covariances converge by ergodicity and finite second moments; Slutsky gives the stated ratio. Gaussian and standardized t3 innovations both have finite variance. The t3 fourth moment is infinite, so no fourth-moment variance theorem is invoked. We now execute all four frozen extension cells.
